entities.title: shell-tools source
entities.summary: Every module of the shell-tools library, flat in one folder: the request dispatcher, the six operations, the session memory, the file loader and the Host interface the daemon implements.
entities.purpose: lib.rs lists the modules. engine.rs keeps one Sent table per session and the Shared memory, and runs a request (or a batch) for a session; req.rs parses requests; read.rs, search.rs, list.rs (list and stat), outline.rs and diff.rs (diff_since and line diffs) are the operations; state.rs holds what was sent, trusted stamps and diff bases; fsio.rs loads and hashes files; host.rs declares what the daemon lends (walk, scan, outlines) and the path helpers.
boundaries: Only reads: no operation writes, renames or deletes a file.
Memory lives in the daemon's process and ends with it; nothing is written to disk.
Walking, scanning and outlining are the daemon's (Host); this folder renders their results as JSON.
